statement: You are given an array nums and an integer target. Put a + or a − sign in front of every element of nums, then add them all up.
Return the number of different ways to choose the signs so that the result equals target.

examples.explanation: +1 − 2 + 1 and −1 + 2 − 1 both give 0. Every other choice of signs gives a non-zero result.
To reach 3, exactly one of the five 1s must be negative, and there are 5 choices for which one.
